verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated writing-skills skill that documents how to author and test new skills: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, then refactor (docs-15, docs-62, docs-50). It also documents where skills live across runtimes (docs-31). However, nothing in the pack shows a concrete SKILL.md template or specifies the name/description frontmatter fields, so the 'from a documented template' part of the story is not evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit SKILL.md template with name/description frontmatter schema, independent or hands-on corroboration that authors can create skills without studying existing ones.
